job.job_description:
Work location - Kochi, Kerala

Job type - Permanent

3-6 years of hands-on experience in performance testing.
In-depth knowledge of web protocols, including HTTP/HTTPS, WebSockets, and/or other protocols.
Solid understanding of related API concepts.
Proficient in using performance testing tools, particularly Apache JMeter.
Strong expertise in performance testing methodologies, best practices, and performance optimization techniques.
Proven experience in executing complex performance testing scenarios and generating realistic load patterns.
Skilled in analyzing performance test results to derive actionable insights regarding application performance under varying load conditions.
Experience in preparing and presenting detailed performance testing reports and results to clients.
Familiarity with API testing tools, such as Postman.
Experience with custom scripting in JMeter using languages like Groovy, Java, or JavaScript is an advantage.
Knowledge of additional performance testing tools, such as LoadRunner, is a plus.
Strong communication skills with a professional and positive attitude.
Should be able to work during overlapping hours or weekend support if required.
